elements.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
elements.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, etc.)
sub_elements.evidence: doi: 10.57895/fairhub.2; id: https://fairhub.io/datasets/2
sub_elements.quality_note: DOI and stable FAIRhub dataset ID both present and well-formed

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: Artificial Intelligence Ready and Equitable Atlas for Diabetes Insights (AI-READI); description spanning ~13 lines covering 4,000 participants, 3 sites, triple-balanced design, multi-domain protocol
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear title and comprehensive (>200 char) description of purpose, scope, and design

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: [Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, T2DM, AI-READI, Machine Learning, ... retinal imaging, continuous glucose monitoring, wearable devices, triple-balanced sampling, health equity, Bridge2AI, ...] (18 keywords)
sub_elements.quality_note: 18 relevant keywords covering domain, methods, modalities, and program

sub_elements.name: Dataset Landing Page or Platform URL
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://fairhub.io/datasets/2
sub_elements.quality_note: Dedicated FAIRhub landing/download page provided

sub_elements.name: Associated Project or Program
sub_elements.evidence: keywords include Bridge2AI; funders: NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program; external_resources: Bridge2AI Program at https://bridge2ai.org/
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear association with NIH Bridge2AI program

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Mechanism Defined
sub_elements.evidence: distributions: 'Public access subset ... available at https://fairhub.io/datasets/2 upon agreement with the CC BY-NC 4.0 license' and 'Controlled access subset requiring a data use agreement'
sub_elements.quality_note: Two-tier access (open public + controlled) clearly defined

sub_elements.name: Data Use Agreement Required?
sub_elements.evidence: confidential_elements: 'A controlled access subset requires a separate data use agreement ... Access requirements are managed by the Data Access Committee'
sub_elements.quality_note: DUA requirement and governing committee explicitly stated

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: distributions[1] format: ZIP, media_type: application/zip, available at https://fairhub.io/datasets/2
sub_elements.quality_note: Direct FAIRhub download portal with archive format specified

sub_elements.name: File Formats Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: DICOM (imaging), CSV (tabular/time-series), mHealth (wearable), XML (ECG); distributions delivered as ZIP
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific per-modality formats enumerated

sub_elements.name: External Links to Similar or Related Datasets
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Zenodo Archive (10.5281/zenodo.10642459), Protocol Publication BMJ Open, Nature Metabolism Commentary, NIH RePORTER, docs.aireadi.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Nine external resources linking to related repositories and documentation

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.evidence: license: CC BY-NC 4.0; license_and_use_terms: 'Permits others to distribute, remix, adapt, build upon this work non-commercially ... provided the original work is properly cited'
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear reuse permissions with named license and full terms

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized
sub_elements.evidence: DICOM for imaging, CSV, mHealth standard for wearables, XML for ECG; preproc: mapping to OMOP Common Data Model
sub_elements.quality_note: Uses widely recognized standard formats and CDM

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies: 'All data mapped to ... Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model for clinical data and DICOM format for retinal imaging'; RxNorm codes, ICD-10 codes referenced
sub_elements.quality_note: OMOP CDM, DICOM, RxNorm, ICD-10 conformance documented (no explicit conforms_to slot in core schema)

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Defined for Linking
sub_elements.evidence: No participant ID scheme, linking key, or identifiers_in_files documented in the core datasheet
sub_elements.quality_note: Cross-domain linking identifiers not specified

sub_elements.name: Documentation of Processing Tools for Reproducibility
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies name REDCap for centralized data management, format conversion pipelines (.fda/.sdt to DICOM, .FIT to mHealth), and named capture devices throughout acquisition_methods
sub_elements.quality_note: Processing pipeline and tools documented, though no code repository or version pins

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review Documented
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: 'Study approved by IRB of University of Washington (approval number STUDY00016228), with reliance agreements from IRBs of University of Alabama at Birmingham and University of California, San Diego'
sub_elements.quality_note: IRB approval number and multi-site reliance agreements documented

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified: 'De-identification procedures follow applicable regulations and guidelines'
sub_elements.quality_note: No specific method named (e.g., HIPAA Safe Harbor, Expert Determination); statement is high-level

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Removed or Masked
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements and is_deidentified: '5-digit zip code, detailed race/ethnicity, genetic data, past health records ... moved to the controlled access dataset'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific identifiers segregated to controlled access are enumerated

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.evidence: informed_consent: 'Written informed consent provided by all participants prior to study enrollment ... reviewed by the Community Advisory Board. Participants may withdraw at any time'
sub_elements.quality_note: Written consent type, process, and withdrawal rights described

sub_elements.name: Ethical Sourcing Statement Included
sub_elements.evidence: human_subject_research and at_risk_populations: bioethics guidance integrated throughout, Community Advisory Board of 11 persons, 'ethical and equitable data collection and management practices'
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit ethical/equitable sourcing statement with governance structures

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Population Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: instances: 'Individual participants aged 40 and older with and without T2DM ... Exclusion criteria include pregnancy and type 1 diabetes'; inclusion/exclusion criteria stated
sub_elements.quality_note: Demographics, age range, and inclusion/exclusion criteria described

sub_elements.name: Number of Participants or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: instances: 'Target enrollment is 4,000 people'; subpopulations each ~1,000 (25%)
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific target counts overall and per subpopulation

sub_elements.name: Modalities or Data Types Listed
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: survey, physical measurements, retinal imaging, visual function, clinical labs, ECG, cognitive, neuropathy, CGM, physical activity, environmental, biospecimen (12 modalities)
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive multi-domain modality enumeration

sub_elements.name: Conditions or Phenotypes Represented
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations: no diabetes, pre-diabetes/lifestyle-controlled, medication-controlled, insulin-controlled T2DM severity groups
sub_elements.quality_note: Four diabetes severity phenotype groups explicitly represented

sub_elements.name: File Dimensions or Sampling Rates Provided
sub_elements.evidence: CGM 'every 5 minutes for 10 days'; environmental sensor 11 light measurements over 10 days; blood '53 mL'; 12-lead ECG; blood pressure 'measured twice separated by 2 minutes'
sub_elements.quality_note: Sampling rates, durations, and measurement dimensions given across modalities

elements.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking
elements.description: Can a user determine dataset versions, update history, and provenance?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Version Number Provided
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_dates and updates reference v1.0.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0; version_access: 'semantic versioning (e.g., v1.0.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0)'

sub_elements.name: Version History Documented

sub_elements.name: Change Descriptions for Each Version

sub_elements.name: Update Schedule or Frequency Indicated

sub_elements.name: Versioned Documentation or External References

sub_elements.quality_note: Version-specific documentation portal referenced

sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: AI-READI Project Website (aireadi.org), Dataset Documentation (docs.aireadi.org with version-specific guides), Data Sharing Information page

sub_elements.name: Similar Dataset Links or Thematic Grouping
sub_elements.evidence: funders and external_resources: Bridge2AI Program (bridge2ai.org) as parent NIH Common Fund program supporting AI-ready biomedical datasets
sub_elements.quality_note: Thematic grouping within the Bridge2AI dataset family

strengths: Complete discovery layer: FAIRhub DOI, stable ID, landing page, 18 keywords, and clear Bridge2AI program association
Two-tier access model (open CC BY-NC 4.0 public subset plus DUA-gated controlled subset) with per-modality file formats fully specified
Exceptionally detailed composition and collection: 4,000 triple-balanced target, 12 acquisition modalities, named devices, sampling rates, and three-site harmonization
Strong version provenance with semantic versioning, dated release history, per-version change notes, and a version-specific documentation portal
Thorough funding transparency (NIH grant OT2OD032644 plus supporting grants) and honest limitations disclosure including volunteer bias and ongoing-enrollment caveats
weaknesses: Deidentification is stated only as following 'applicable regulations and guidelines' without naming a specific method (HIPAA Safe Harbor, Expert Determination, etc.)
No cross-domain linking identifier or participant-ID scheme documented to support integration of the multimodal files
No open-source preprocessing or feature-extraction code repositories linked
recommendations: Name the specific deidentification method applied to the public subset (e.g., HIPAA Safe Harbor vs Expert Determination) and where it is documented
Document the participant/record identifier scheme and any linking keys used across imaging, clinical, wearable, and biospecimen domains
Link GitHub or equivalent repositories for the format-conversion and QC pipelines to support reproducibility
Add an explicit conflicts-of-interest declaration for the investigator team
